dedupe_keys.name: twenty two building management systems with periodic alarm labels

description: This Zenodo release provides timestamped binary alarm and reset events from twenty-two building-management systems across nine countries and seven market segments, including education, healthcare and transport. The current version 1.0.1 describes 321 distinct alarm series with periodicity labels and predefined training and test subsets. Its public file inventory contains five Parquet files, including an ambiguous-label group, under CC BY 4.0. The article-linked concept DOI points to an older four-file version whose description directs users to this newer record. A GitHub companion contains exploration notebooks under BSD-3-Clause; that code licence is separate from the data rights. These are sampled alarm streams, not complete BMS control logic or verified fault root causes. Uneven building types, limited observation windows and label ambiguity are limitations for operational anomaly simulations. A reviewer-assessed use is testing alarm-noise or periodic-event handling in a building digital twin. data-collectief-alesund-bms-energy is a related BMS resource from another site; no schema conversion was tested. No Parquet file or notebook was downloaded.
